name: Miro MCP
description: Lets agents read, search, and build Miro boards over a hosted OAuth MCP server, including SVG-based diagrams, tables, comments, and prototypes.

skills.name: Board Search
skills.description: Searches and lists the Miro boards the current user can access, and creates new boards from a prompt.

skills.name: Canvas SVG Editing
skills.description: Reads board items as SVG and applies SVG diffs to create, update, or delete items, including Mermaid diagrams.

skills.name: Comment Handling
skills.description: Lists comments on a board or a specific item, replies to comment threads, and resolves or unresolves them.

skills.name: Prototype Screens
skills.description: Reads prototype screens and metadata from a board, and creates Miro prototypes from one or more HTML screens.
